datasets.title: Uganda - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows Uganda catchment areas with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/uganda-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded data, assigning representative points, and using Voronoi tessellation to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts from WorldPop (2020) and META (2023) were disaggregated by sex and age within each catchment. Building counts and footprint data from OpenStreetMap and Google imagery were spatially intersected with catchment polygons to provide infrastructure inventory.

sources.description: High-resolution population data disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) integrated into settlement catchment areas

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint inventory used to count structures within settlement catchments

sources.name: Google
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building detections at multiple confidence thresholds and average footprint areas
